name: heads-up-telegram
description: Telegram group digests with one-tap AI replies for Even Realities G2 glasses

scripts.build: esbuild web/src/main.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/dist/app.js && cp web/index.html web/dist/ && cp web/public/* web/dist/
scripts.pack: npm run build && evenhub pack app.json web/dist -o out/heads-up.ehpk
